India sees fuel price fluctuations amid global oil market shifts

India's petrol and diesel prices have seen updates following changes in the global crude oil market. Saudi Arabia's decision to reduce crude oil prices coincided with these domestic adjustments. Meanwhile, US actions against Iran have also contributed to volatility in international oil prices, impacting potential relief for consumers.
